announcements.title: Nationals Test Launch
announcements.body: Testing rockets for nationals at 60 Acres North Field. Dress for weather and muddy conditions. Bring: hard-boiled eggs and flight recording materials.

announcements.title: Weekly Club Meeting
announcements.body: Regular club meeting in Science Building 201. We'll discuss upcoming competitions and work on current projects. All members welcome!

announcements.title: New Members Welcome
announcements.body: Interested in rocketry? Join our club! No experience needed - we'll teach you everything from rocket design to launch procedures.
